description:
Review finding from worktree-qzr2-wal-trim. Related to bedrock-wxf.6, but this ticket is the correctness defect in the current Olivine compaction path.

Problem:
Olivine continues accepting and applying synchronous ingest calls while background compaction captures an older durable snapshot. The stream puller advances after each acknowledged ingest. At compaction_ready, Server replaces the index with only the captured durable version, clears the intake queue, and retains the already-advanced pull task. Transactions ingested during compaction therefore vanish from the materializer until a later recovery or restart rewinds the stream.

Impact:
Reads can lose previously visible committed state after compaction.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every transaction accepted during compaction remains readable after cutover.
- The solution either preserves/replays the post-snapshot suffix or safely stops and restarts the puller from the compacted durable boundary.
- Backpressured pending ingest callers are handled correctly during success, failure, lock, and shutdown paths.
- A deterministic concurrency test holds compaction open, ingests a suffix, completes cutover, and verifies all suffix versions and values without restarting the materializer.
- The test verifies the stream resumes without duplicates or gaps.
title: Preserve live Olivine ingestion across compaction cutover
